verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway exposes a documented RESTful Admin API (kong-gh-5, kong-gh-10) and Konnect provides a directory of OpenAPI specs for various Kong APIs (kong-docs-9), plus decK and Inso CLI for declarative/automated API-driven management, giving AI-native users a documented programmatic path to drive the product. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger.json at the standard endpoints (probe found 404s at candidate paths), which would strengthen agent-native consumption.
